camel_example: aliyun adb DescribeProcessList --region cn-hangzhou --Order '[{"Field":"Time","Type":"Desc"},{"Field":"User","Type":"Asc"}]' --User test --Keyword SELECT --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --DBClusterId 'am-bp11q28kvl6880000' --RunningTime 5 --ShowFull true
description_en: Queries the queries that are being executed on a cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeProcessList接口查看实例正在运行的查询
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-process-list --db-cluster-id am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --show-full true --running-time 5 --user test --keyword SELECT --order '[{"Field":"Time","Type":"Desc"},{"Field":"User","Type":"Asc"}]' --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeProcessList

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to show a complete SQL statement. Valid values:

True: shows a complete SQL statement.
False: shows only the first 100 characters of an SQL statement.

The default value is False
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示完整的SQL语句。取值说明：
True：展示完整的SQL语句。
False：只展示SQL语句的前100个字符。

默认值False
parameters.name: show_full

parameters.help_en: The execution duration used to filter queries. Queries that take a longer time than the specified execution duration are displayed. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 按运行时间过滤，展示大于该运行时间的查询。单位：秒
parameters.name: running_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the user used to filter queries
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en: The keyword in an SQL statement, which is used to filter queries. Set the value to SELECT
parameters.help_zh: 过滤关键字，目前仅支持过滤SELECT
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The order in which queries are sorted based on the specified fields. Specify this parameter as an ordered JSON array in the `[{"Field":"Time","Type":"Desc" },{ "Field":"User", "Type":"Asc" }]` format.

Field specifies the field used to sort queries. Valid values: Time, User, Host, and DB.
Type specifies the sorting sequence. Valid values: Desc and Asc
parameters.help_zh:
按指定字段排序，JSON格式，`[{"Field":"Time","Type":"Desc" },{ "Field":"User", "Type":"Asc" }]`，取值说明：
Field：需要排序的字段名，支持Time，User，Host，DB字段。
Type：排序类型，Desc为降序，Asc为升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为：大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

Command.description_en: The type of the statement. Only SELECT can be returned

Host.description_en: The IP address from which the query was initiated

Id.description_en: The ID of the worker thread

Info.description_en: The SQL statement that is being executed. By default, the first 100 characters of the SQL statement are returned. If the ShowFull parameter is set to True, the complete SQL statement is returned
Info.description_zh: 正在运行的SQL语句，默认返回前100字符。当传入参数ShowFull为True时，显示全文

ProcessId.description_en: The unique ID of the query. You must specify this parameter when you use the KILL PROCESS statement
ProcessId.description_zh: 任务的唯一标识，KILL PROCESS时使用

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 任务的开始时间，UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Time.description_en: The amount of time that has elapsed from the start time of the query. Unit: seconds
Time.description_zh: 查询任务已运行时间。单位：秒

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The total number of pages returned

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
